title: Resting-pressure context of exercise angina: a negative incremental-prediction test across two hospitals
abstract: Resting systolic-pressure-by-exercise-angina did not establish incremental angiographic CAD prediction: Cleveland cross-validated Brier gain -0.002448; independent-institution Hungarian gain 0.002226 (500 joint source-refit/target bootstrap 95% interval [-0.006616, 0.014813]). A source-trained ridge logistic model with flexible additive routine predictors was compared against the same model plus one registered product. Cleveland n=303;Hungary n=284. Distinct institutional datasets provide retrospective external validation,not untouched prospective confirmation. The target point improvement did not overcome the failed source and uncertainty criteria. This does not establish physiological equivalence.
